items.meta_description: VpnHood! – A free, secure, and open-source VPN with a global server network designed to protect your online privacy and ensure secure access to the web.
items.page_desc: Fast, secure, and reliable VPN solution powered by VpnHood! Engine, which is open-source and the first VPN developed fully with the .NET platform.
items.intro: VpnHood! CLIENT is available for Android, Android TV, Windows, and Linux, providing a seamless VPN experience for users. Key features include:
items.li_fast: Fast and secure VPN connections powered by VpnHood Engine.
items.li_protocol: Steadfast protocol to ensures a smooth, encrypted connection, maintaining a private online presence across various network environments.
items.li_cloak: Cloak Mode for networks that actively probe for VPNs: the connection is deliberately shaped to look like ordinary web traffic, and unauthenticated probes get a plain web-server response instead of anything worth testing.
items.li_proxy: Proxy Mode reaches your server through a SOCKS or HTTP proxy when a direct connection is blocked, which also makes it easy to relay through another network.
items.li_split: Split tunneling for apps, IPs, domains, and country-based filtering.
items.screenshot_home_alt: VpnHood! CLIENT on a phone, connected, showing live download and upload speed with split tunneling and protocol options
items.screenshot_servers_alt: The Servers screen in VpnHood! CLIENT, listing a public and a private access-key profile with their server locations
items.win_title: The same app on your desktop
items.win_desc: VpnHood! CLIENT runs on Windows and Linux too — the interface you know, in a compact window that stays out of the way. Paste an access key once, and your servers are a click away.
